mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sms_verification_challenge (id, purpose, phone_fingerprint, browser_fingerprint, actor_user_id, scheme_name, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{purpose}, #{phoneFingerprint}, #{browserFingerprint}, #{actorUserId}, #{schemeName}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sms_verification_challenge SET state = 'SENT' WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'SENDING' AND expires_at > clock_timestamp()

UPDATE sms_verification_challenge SET state = 'VERIFYING', attempts = attempts + 1, verification_token = #{token} WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'SENT' AND attempts < 5 AND expires_at > clock_timestamp()

UPDATE sms_verification_challenge SET state = CASE WHEN #{passed} THEN 'VERIFIED' WHEN attempts >= 5 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'SENT' END, verification_token = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'VERIFYING' AND verification_token = #{token} AND expires_at > clock_timestamp()
UPDATE sms_verification_challenge SET state = 'FAILED', verification_token = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND state IN ('SENDING', 'VERIFYING')
UPDATE sms_verification_challenge SET state = 'CONSUMED', result_user_id = #{userId}, result_code = #{code} WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'VERIFIED' AND expires_at > clock_timestamp()
